title: jasper-deploy jrs.config.json
description: The skill's local connection config (jrs.config.json in the skill root, gitignored). All jasper-deploy scripts resolve credentials in order: script params -> env JRS_URL/JRS_USER/JRS_PASS (and JR_LIB_DIR) -> this file. Copy jrs.config.example.json to jrs.config.json and fill it in. Unknown keys are allowed.

serverUrl.description: Base URL of the JasperReports Server, e.g. http://localhost:8081/jasperserver-pro (no trailing slash; scripts trim one anyway). Overridden by -ServerUrl or $env:JRS_URL.

user.description: JRS user for HTTP Basic auth, e.g. superuser. Overridden by -User or $env:JRS_USER.

password.description: Password for the JRS user. Overridden by -Password or $env:JRS_PASS. Keep this file gitignored.

dataSourceUri.description: Optional default datasource repository URI used as a fallback when a script's -DataSourceUri is not supplied, e.g. /datasources/postgis_34_sample.

jrLibDir.description: Optional path to the JasperReports 7 runtime jar directory used for local compile/render, e.g. C:\Users\rgorsuch\jasperreports-lib. Overridden by -LibDir or $env:JR_LIB_DIR; defaults to that path if unset.
